newsitem.title: USA: Marquee files for 8.6 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Marquee files for 8.6 mln shr offering.

text.p: The Marquee Group Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the proposed offering of about 8.6 million shares of common stock.
The offering will be led by Prudential Securities Cowen & Co. All of the shares are being sold by the company.

The company also noted that it has applied to the American Stock Exchange to list the common stock under the symbol MRQ, and that it expects shares to begin trading there before the offering is completed.
